## 1. Goal

Make Run a calm stage: exact resource numbers on top, waiting jobs with live scores on the left, a large timeline in the middle, a translucent control dock at the bottom and a Why sheet on the right.

## 2. Background

**Design authority:** `docs/design/APPLE_DESIGN.md` (added by K-43). Direction "soft sheets": flat solid colours, hairline borders, one whisper shadow, translucent top bar and dock (`backdrop-filter`, solid fallback under `prefers-reduced-transparency` and `prefers-contrast: more`), no gradients except the scroll-edge fade, no glows, neon, purple, emoji icons or monospace fonts. System sans-serif only; numbers use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

**Palette (final):** light canvas `#F2F3F1`, surface `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1F1D`, muted `#5B625E`, border `#CFD3D0`, accent teal `#0B5E6B`, red `#B42318`, amber `#8A4B00`, green `#1D7A34`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Dark: canvas `#121513`, surface `#1B1F1D`, text `#ECEFED`, muted `#A3ABA6`, border `#343A37`, accent `#5FB6C4`, red `#F0877C`, amber `#E0A24A`, green `#6FCB87`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Chart gray is for chart marks and rules only, never text.

**Rules that do not change (CLAUDE.md rule 7, PRD §7 and §8):** classic scripts on `window.APRM`, no ES modules, no `fetch`, no framework, no build step; works from `file://` offline; `textContent` only for user, file, URL and engine text; loading, empty and error states on every view; colours as CSS variables with light and dark values; Chart.js only in Compare, pinned with SRI, with a table fallback. Nothing here touches `core/`, `wasm/` or PRD §5, and every number shown must equal the engine JSON.

**Tone:** short plain sentences, sentence case, talk to the user. Plain words first, technical term beside them ("Shortest job first (SJF)"). Engine sentences (why log, validation errors) are shown verbatim; the UI may add a plain lead-in but never rewrites them. "Show details" (K-43) reveals the full technical view: exact numbers, raw aged keys, heap order, log kinds.

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- Resource strip: CPU and memory used, free and capacity as exact numbers
- Waiting list with live aged scores; Show details adds raw key and heap order
- Timeline canvas restyled: 10 muted colour-blind-safe job colours (CSS variables), number label on every block, 3 hatch patterns, system sans-serif text read from CSS
- Control dock: Run, Play or Pause, Step, Jump to end, Reset, speed; "More settings" for alpha, T and epsilon with plain hints, exact values always shown in a summary line
- Why sheet: engine sentence verbatim, plain kind label (details also shows the raw kind), filter by job
- Reserved-job card with shadow time and spare room; all metrics including wait by priority, plain label plus technical term
- Add a job at the current time, restyled

**Out of scope:**

- Compare page
- Any engine or API change; metrics must equal the engine JSON

## 5. Specification

Palette size becomes 10 in canvas.js (`paletteIndex` mod 10) and compare.js; hatch pattern = id mod 3. Colours and fonts are read from CSS variables, falling back to the palette constants. Steps per frame stay capped; Jump to end stays sliced. Plan first: post the plan (files, functions, tests, complexity) as an issue comment, then implement.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Post the plan as an issue comment
2. Write the number-equality test first
3. Restyle resource strip, waiting list, dock, Why sheet
4. Update canvas.js colours, labels, hatch
5. Check reduced motion, keyboard, six presets play to the end
6. Screenshots light and dark before and after

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| run-numbers | Rendered resource, score and metric text equals the engine JSON for the six presets | Equal |
| run-keys | Space and Right arrow drive the player | Pass |
| run-details | Show details adds raw key, heap order and log kind | Present only when on |
| palette-10 | Ten distinct job colours and 3 hatches; ids above 10 wrap | Pass |
| reserve-card | Reserved job shows shadow time and spare room | Equal to engine state |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Resource strip, waiting list, timeline, dock and Why sheet laid out as planned
- [ ] Every number equals the engine JSON; details toggle shows the full technical view
- [ ] Colour never the only signal (labels and hatching)
- [ ] Six presets load, play, step and finish; a job added mid-run is scheduled
- [ ] node tests/web/*.mjs green; file:// offline; screenshots in the PR

## 9. How to verify

`node tests/web/*.mjs`; in the browser run each preset to the end with details on and off.

## 10. Viva notes

The page draws what the engine reports and never decides. Examiner question: "Why did job 7 wait?" The Why sheet shows the engine's own sentence.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Rounding or reformatting engine numbers
- Canvas text not following dark mode
- Animating on every frame (keep compositor-only properties)
